source_of_truth: Kuschi service-size corrections. Base recipes remain riviera_sources/current/Riviera_Recipe_Catalog_Source_Of_Truth_2026-07-08.json unless explicitly superseded.

rules.base_recipe_source: Use the structured Riviera recipe catalog as the current active recipe base; riviera_data/builtins.json is the synced website copy.
rules.portion_locking: Do not invent missing service sizes. Ask Kuschi before locking tapas, canape, plated, buffet or corporate portions unless a clear repeated Kuschi-approved pattern already exists.
rules.pattern_inference_rule: Pattern-inferred quantities may be confirmed only when they follow repeated Kuschi-approved logic: buffet uses service target plus production buffer, sauce and garnish are given per guest, premium garnish is called out, and fragile formats are marked not_recommended rather than forced.
rules.status_locking: confirmed is locked; needs_confirmation is allowed in normal audit but blocks strict audit; not_recommended is allowed only with a clear reason or note.
rules.premium_garnish_rule: Always call out the optional premium garnish where one exists. Keep the standard garnish practical, and list the premium garnish as an upgrade rather than silently replacing the standard.
rules.dessert_variant_rule: Use normal keys where they are clear. Use plated_dessert, roving_dessert, dessert_buffet and dessert_platter only when a normal savoury key would be confusing.
rules.naming_locking: Use master_variant_keys for normal service variants. Special-purpose keys are allowed only when listed in special_variant_keys and documented with status, note/reason and clear service use.
rules.platter_locking: Platter records may use count by ordered pieces when the built-in recipe already defines the platter yield. Corporate boxed variants are only confirmed where the format holds well in delivery.

meatball_naming.note: Use 60 g pre-crumb weight as active standard. 80 g is substantial canape only if explicitly requested. Older mini canape and buffet albondigas drafts are service variants, not separate production recipes.

plated_entree.note: Make separate 50 g plated batch before crumbing.
